def get_all_contacts_by_relationship(relationship):
    contacts = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        contacts.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return contacts
